svg.style: font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;
svg.title: DataTalk.AI DataFlow Diagram
svg.text: How a plain-English question becomes a verified, data-backed answer

g.text: Typed, or spoken and reviewed before sending
Validates input (3–2,000 characters) and routes the request.
Quick-action keywords go to deterministic analytics; open questions go to AI.
Every AI step receives the approved schema, agreed metric
definitions and real data values; the planner also sees recent chat.
• Splits the message into up to 5 sub-questions
• Identifies metrics, filters, groupings and dependencies
Output: a checked, structured plan of sub-questions

svg.text: FOR EACH SUB-QUESTION · dependent sub-questions run last and receive upstream results

g.text: Turns each sub-question into one read-only database query
Runs validated SQL on Databricks (max 5,000 rows).
No rows or a query error:
✓ Evidence Check: AI sentences with unverified numbers or causal claims
are removed and replaced by the data-grounded version
Multi-part questions only: combines sub-answers and runs a
QA review for gaps or unsupported claims. Single questions skip it.
Answer first, then charts, insight panel, and the exact query.

svg.text: Consistent AI: same settings every time · every AI reply is format-checked and retried if invalid · if a step still fails, its backup takes over
